Interface WriterDao

All Known Implementing Classes:
WriterDaoImpl
public interface WriterDao
Data access contract for Writer records. Author: Farid Rahmani Contribution: Defined the DAO interface so controllers/services depend on an abstraction, not a concrete JDBC implementation. Purpose: decouples the rest of the application from how writers are persisted (MySQL today, something else tomorrow) by depending on this interface rather than a concrete implementation.
